evidence: deepseek-v4-flash: "Group triples by a"; gpt-oss-120b: "columns: 0..k-1" and "col_rows"
affordance_in_statement: For every available model, these three parameters are values between 1 and k inclusive; select exactly k resonator models; two resonator models are isolated if they differ in their frequency multiplier, and they differ in their phase shift, and they differ in their amplitude scale.
removal_suggestion: No semantics-preserving wording change can remove this structure: with k choices from each of three k-element domains and pairwise inequality in every coordinate, the task intrinsically is a three-dimensional matching/exact-cover problem. Removing it would require changing an immutable bound or changing the task.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses the pigeonhole consequence that a valid solution contains exactly one model for each first-coordinate value, then searches within groups.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: the parameters are between 1 and k inclusive, exactly k models must be selected, and selected models must differ in every coordinate

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Translates each candidate model into an exact-cover row covering one value in each of three coordinate partitions.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: two selected models must differ in all three parameters, with each parameter drawn from 1 through k

common_affordance: The intrinsic reduction to selecting k rows with one distinct value in each of three k-element coordinate domains, equivalently a three-dimensional exact-cover instance.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Enumerates all k-element combinations from as many as k^3 catalog entries and checks every pair, which is infeasible under the stated limits.
Relies on factorial permutation enumeration/construction rather than a scalable exact-cover search, so it does not reliably handle the allowed k up to 22 and was judged wrong.

recommended_edit: No valid single edit is available without changing the immutable numeric structure or the underlying task; both surviving solutions directly implement the required exact-cover search rather than relying on incidental wording.
